concepts.def: Universe began hot and dense ~13.8 billion years ago.
Space itself is stretching, carrying galaxies apart.
Light from receding galaxies shifts to longer wavelengths.

Cosmic Microwave Background, ~2.7 K relic radiation.
Study of origin, structure and fate of the universe.

walkthroughs.body_html: ~13.8 billion years ago the universe was extremely hot and dense and has been expanding and cooling ever since. Galaxies are not flying through space; rather, space itself stretches between them.
In the 1920s, Hubble showed that more distant galaxies have larger redshifts — meaning faster recession. This pattern is exactly what an expanding universe predicts.
The hot early universe filled with light. As space expanded, this light cooled into microwaves now seen everywhere at ~2.7 K. Predicted in 1948, discovered 1965.
